description: The figure is a multi-level (sunburst-style) pie chart representing medical ethics principles and their associated subtopics, with 4 main inner slices and a larger set of outer slices detailing specific items under each principle. The inner ring contains four categories: Beneficence (blue, the largest segment at roughly about half of the circle), Autonomy (green, about a quarter), Non-Maleficence (purple, smaller at roughly around one-sixth), and Justice (orange, the smallest at roughly around one-tenth). The outer ring subdivides each principle into labeled slices of roughly equal width within each group: Beneficence (blue) includes items such as “Recognize the Responsibility of the Occupation,” “Comply with Laws and Regulations,” “Provide Medical Care to Patients,” “Continual Learning,” “Provide Assistance in Emergency,” “Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues,” “Respect Life, Dignity of Patients,” “Give Top Priority to Patient’s Interest in Conflict of Interest,” “Minimizing Conflicts of Interest,” “Ethical research,” and “Open Discussion and Fair Charging of Fees”; Autonomy (green) includes “Informed Decision-making of Incompetent/Competent Patient,” “Respect Patient’s Rights to be Informed, Freedom of Choice,” “Maintain Truthful, Factual Communication,” “Keep Confidential of Patient’s Information,” “Professional Relationship with Patients and Their Relatives,” “Make Responsible and Independent Clinical Judgement,” and “Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve”; Non-Maleficence (purple) includes “Do Not Use Medicine for Personal Gain,” “Report Unethical and Unprofessional Conduct,” “Maintain Qualified When Providing Medical Care,” and “Prevent Patient from Harm”; and Justice (orange) includes “Treat Patients Fairly and Equally,” “Allocate Medical Sources Fairly,” “Promote Environmental Sustainability,” and “Promote the Health of Community and Public Education.” There is no separate legend and no numeric percentage labels shown inside slices; the chart relies on direct text labels and color coding, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond the hierarchical ring structure.
